name: Breaker Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an orange fuse-box cabinet whose open door carries Rotom's grinning face, full of breaker switches
entry: It lives in fuse boxes and flips its switches for fun. When it trips, every light in the house goes out and it sulks.
how: Use a Circuit Fuse on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Earth Power in this form.
